Commentary.Commentary: Shikhar Dhawan is handed the trophy and he goes on to share it with his teammates and they all pose for a picture. Right then! That ends South Africa's tour of India. The hosts have won both the T20I series and the ODI series as well. Both sides will now play the mega event in Australia. For now, it's goodbye!

Shikhar Dhawan says that he is really proud of the boys and the way they played showing maturity. Adds that they created a great atmosphere and showed great character after being 1-0 down. Claims that they never really put pressure on themselves and they knew that if they stuck to the basics, the results would come on their own. Mentions that the wickets weren't batting friendly but the batters did a good job and the bowlers exploited the wicket well.

Mohammed Siraj is the Player of the Series and he says that whenever he bowls he gives his 100 percent. Adds that with the new ball he tries to find the right area but he pulls his length back a bit after 15 overs since it does not swing as much. Mentions that as fast bowlers sometimes they have to be aggressive and have that fire.

Kuldeep Yadav is the Player of the Match for figures of 4 wickets for 18 runs. He says that he is very happy to get the award after coming back from an injury. Claims that he is in a great rhythm and the wicket also provided assistance. Claims that before his injury he was out of touch and now he wants to keep doing the right thing.

David Miller the captain of South Africa says that their batting was not up to the mark, scoring 99 did not help. Adds that it is a disappointing result and to finish the series like this is disappointing. Adds that the pitch was a bit two-paced, it was skidding on there was turn on offer as well, a bit tacky. Mentions that they were good in certain areas, they did manage to find their feet. But they need to perform better in ODIs.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Shubman Gill is up for a chat and he says that he is a bit disappointed with the way he got out but he is happy with this win and they have done well to get back after the first game. Mentions that it has been a pleasing series for them and a lot of young players including himself handled the pressure well. Adds that the talk in the management was just to express themselves and not to think about the bigger picture. Admits that there are exciting times ahead with the 50-over World Cup coming back.

The game was won by India in the first inning itself as the bowlers demolished the South African batting lineup. The spinners were on song as Kuldeep Yadav was the pick of the bowlers claiming four wickets with Washington Sundar, Shahbaz Ahmed, and Mohammed Siraj chipping in with two wickets each. Heinrich Klaasen was the only batter who looked like he could score freely but the rest was dismissed cheaply as they were unable to reach the 100-run mark. The Indian batters completed the formality thereafter and India have inflicted a series loss to Mark Boucher in his last series as head coach of the South African side.

India started the run chase looking solid and scoring boundaries at regular intervals. Shubman Gill displayed an array of gorgeous stroke-play as Shikhar Dhawan looked to play the anchor role. Some lazy running from the latter resulted in him being run out cheaply but they had put on a 42-run opening partnership until then. Ishan Kishan came into the bat but was dismissed by Bjorn Fortuin as he looked to take the attack to the spinner. Shreyas Iyer walked out to the middle and joined forces with Shubman Gill to take their team close to the finish line. The young opener fell one run short of what would have been a well-constructed half-century and looked in fine touch through the inning. None of the South African bowlers looked threatening enough to cause a collapse of a strong batting side and in the end succumbed to a feeble loss.

Shreyas Iyer has ended the game in style and it aptly defines his performance in this series! This has been a stunning win for India’s reserve side as they have completed a comprehensive 7-wicket win with almost 31 overs to spare and seal a 2-1 series win. The youngsters have done really well for the hosts and the future definitely looks bright for Indian cricket. The Proteas will be going to the T20 World Cup and would have hoped to do so with a series win under their belt but that is not to be. They will need to pick themselves up from this disappointment and do not have much time to do so before the mega event.

SIX! Shreyas Iyer finishes things in a fine fashion. On a length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer stays in his crease and smokes it over mid off all the way for a biggie! India win by 7 wickets and seal the series 2-1.
Angling in, a fuller ball, around middle. Sanju Samson flicks it towards the fielder at square leg. India will have to wait for another over to finish this off.
Pitches this one up, outside off. Sanju Samson looks to drive this one but he checks his shot in the end and ends up blocking it.
Width on offer now, a shortish ball. Sanju Samson cuts through point for a brace.
A length ball, outside off. Sanju Samson punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Sanju Samson walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Lungi Ngidi sends back Shubman Gill on 49! He has missed out on a well-deserved half-century. South Africa have another breakthrough, probably a little late now. A length ball, tailing back in, around middle. Shubman Gill looks to flick this one but he misses and gets rapped on his pads. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. That is as plumb as it gets. Shubman Gill does not bother reviewing that, he walks back.
A dot to begin the over! On a length, outside off. Shubman Gill gets on top of that one and knocks it towards cover.
FOUR! Nicely done! Marco Jansen drops it short, around off. Shreyas Iyer leans back, opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a boundary. India are only 3 away.
On a length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Goes over the wicket now, he serves a short ball, around off. Shreyas Iyer pulls this one towards square leg. The ball falls just short of the fielder there.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shubman Gill pulls this one towards deep mid-wicker for a single.
Angling in, around middle and off, at around 137.4 clicks. Shubman Gill blocks it back ti the bowler.
A shortish ball, around middle and leg, at around 131 clicks. Shubman Gill pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace. India need 8 more.

DRINKS! This has been a walk in the park for the Indian side so far and unless they collapse drastically this should be a routine win. South Africa have lacked the penetration to take an early wicket and are staring down the barrel of defeat. This game should not last too long after the break.
A shortish ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer knocks it off the back foot towards point. India are 10 runs away now.
Offer width now, fraction short. Shreyas Iyer cuts it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Quick single! A good-length delivery, outside off. Shubman Gill dabs it towards cover and scampers across to the other end.
Around middle and leg now, on a length. Gill tucks it towards square leg. No run there!
FOUR! Oh, glorious! A length ball, outside off. Shubman Gill creams his drive through cover for a gorgeous boundary.
Angling in, a length ball, around off. Shubman Gill gets on top that and blocks it out.
Fraction short again, around off. Shreyas Iyer pulls it towards mid on. The fielder there dives and manages to get his hand to it. Two taken.
Another short ball, around middle and off. Gill pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! This time it is in the gap! Offers a bit of width here, serves it slightly shorter. Shubman Gill gets on top of that one and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
On a length delivery, outside off. Shubman Gill pushes it off the back foot towards cover. Not in the gap though!
Angling in now, a length delivery, around off. Shubman Gill rocks back and blocks it out.
A length delivery, outside off. Shreyas Iyer looks to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
This is outside the off pole and persists with bowling on a good length, Shubman Gill flicks this towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowls this on a good length as outside the off pole, Shubman Gill is solid in defense as he taps the ball back towards the bowler.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Shubman Gill is quick to pounce on this as he pulls this ball towards deep square leg for a brace.
Continues bowling on a good length and just outside off, Shubman Gill knocks this straight to mid on.
This is on a good length and angled into the pads, Shubman Gill blocks this towards short mid-wicket.
Lungi Ngidi bowls a full delivery outside off, Shubman Gill hits this firmly towards cover and a good stop from the fielder saves four runs.
This is bowled back of a length as well and just outside off, Shreyas Iyer defends this to the off side.
Delivers this one outside the off stump on a shorter length, Shreyas Iyer gets on his toes and fends this towards the point fielder.
This is on a good length as well and nipping back into the batter, Shubman Gill gets an inside edge towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Shubman Gill leaves it alone as it zips through to the keeper.
This is wide outside off on a good length, Shubman Gill punches this to the off side but cannot find the gap.
Anrich Nortje begins the over with a fullish delivery outside off, Shubman Gill strokes this to the right of mid off.
Loopy delivery bowled full and in line with the stumps, Shreyas Iyer mistimes his flick towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowls this one outside off on a fuller length, Shreyas Iyer taps this to the left of the bowler.

FOUR! Second boundary in the over and Shreyas Iyer has hit this even better! Another overpitched delivery, around middle. Shreyas Iyer hammers it over the umpire's head and down the ground for a boundary. The umpire there does well to get away from that one.
This is full and straight, Shreyas Iyer blocks this back to the bowler.

FOUR! Shreyas Iyer is showing why he is in such good form! This has been powered along the ground for a boundary. This is full and in line with the stumps, Shreyas Iyer thumps this to straight long on for a boundary.
Bjorn Fortuin flights the ball full and outside off, Shubman Gill strokes this towards long off for a single.
Back of a length, around the off pole. Shreyas Iyer defends it back to the bowler.
Shortish ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer looks to cut this one away but he fails to get any on it.
On a length, around off, at around 151 clicks. Shreyas Iyer gets on top of that one and blocks it out.

SIX! That is a dropped catch and the miss adds six runs to the score! Anrich Nortje bowls this short and outside the off stump, Shreyas Iyer gets on his toes and uppercuts the ball towards third man. Marco Jansen gets a hold of the ball but is going over the boundary. He tries to flick the ball back in but spills the ball as he tries to catch it once again. They go upstairs to check and replays show that he was still inside the boundary when he tries to flick the ball back in and is given as a maximum.
Is that a maximum? Yes, Marco Jansen juggles with the catch. But as he throws the ball in the air, he is in contact with the boundary ropes. Good effort, but a six is given.

This is on a good length as well and outside off, Shreyas Iyer taps this towards cover and takes off for a run. Shubman Gill sends him back and there is a driect hit from Heinrich Klaasen. The replays show that he is home safe.
Anrich Nortje bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Shreyas Iyer blocks this to the right of mid off.
This is outside the off pole on a fuller length, Shreyas Iyer works this towards point and takes a single to get off the mark.
This one is full as well and outside off, Shreyas Iyer knocks this back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Shreyas Iyer makes his way out in the middle.

CAUGHT BEHIND! Bjorn Fortuin gets the wicket of Ishan Kishan right after a boundary! He bowls this full and gets the ball to keep its line beating the inside edge of Ishan Kishan's bat as he plays for the turn. The South African fielders around the bat are celebrating after Quinton de Kock pouches the ball and the umpire raises his finger. Ishan Kishan reviews this straight away and UltraEdge shows a faint edge. The on-field decision stays and India have lost their second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Bjorn Fortuin

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Ishan Kishan attacks the spinner right away! A loopy delivery served full and outside off, Ishan Kishan charges down the wicket and heaves this to the leg side The ball races away to the deep square leg boundary for four runs.
This is flighted full and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan knocks this towards deep cover-point for a single.
This is flighted full and angled into the stumps, Shubman Gill blocks this back to the bowler.
Powerplay 2! South Africa will be allowed to place 4 fielders outside the inner circle until the 40th over.
Anrich Nortje ends the over with a short ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan looks to pull but he sways away from it. India are 53 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Outside off, a length delivery. Ishan Kishan stays in his crease and punches it towards cover.
Fuller ball, around off. Ishan Kishan looks to drive this one but the ball goes off the bottom towards mid-wicket.
FOUR LEG BYES! Anrich Nortje bowls it again around the leg pole, on a length. Ishan Kishan misses his flick. The ball brushes off his pads towards fine leg for a boundary.
A length delivery now, around the leg pole. Ishan Kishan tucks it towards the fielder at square leg.
Good bumper once again from Anrich Nortje! Around middle, and Ishan Kishan sways away from it.
Another dot ball! Darting it on the pads, full in length. Shubman Gill taps it to square leg.
Fullish delivery again, around middle and leg. Gill nudges it towards square leg.
Bjorn Fortuin goes over the wicket now, he pitches it up, on middle. Gill blocks it out.
Ishan Kishan takes the aerial route now but the ball lands safely. Tosses it up, serves it full, around off. Ishan Kishan lifts it just over cover. Only a single.
Wide of off, fuller ball. Ishan Kishan leans in and drives it towards cover.
FOUR! Ishan Kishan gets his first boundary! Outside off, short one now. Ishan Kishan stays in his crease square-cuts it through point for a boundary.
A dot to end! A tidy over from Anrich Nortje. Pitched up, around middle, at around 148 kph. Shubman Gill pushes it back to the ball.
Bowls this on a length, around the off pole, at 146.8 clicks. Shubman Gill defends it out towards cover-point.
A good-length delivery, outside off, at 146 kph. Shubman Gill dabs it off the back foot towards point.
Outside off, slightly short, at 150 clicks this time. Ishan Kishan stands tall and taps it towards cover-point for a single.
Lovely ball! Short ball, around middle, at 142.2 clicks. Ishan Kishan sways away from that one. A well-directed bumper from Anrich Nortje.
Quick single! A fuller ball, around middle, at 149 clicks. Shubman Gill pushes it towards mid on and takes a single.
Around the leg pole, fullish ball again. Ishan Kishan nudges it towards square leg. A maiden over for Bjorn Fortuin on his first over.
Fuller ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan blocks it out.
This is closer to the off stump on a fuller length, Ishan Kishan blocks this watchfully to the bowler's left side.
Fires this one full and outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward and leaves this one alone.
This is floated full and outside the off pole, Ishan Kishan gets across the stumps and blocks it to the bowler's left.
Ishan Kishan is the new batter out in the middle at number 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! South Africa have got their first breakthrough! Shikhar Dhawan has been sent back to the hut. Certainly not the way he would have liked to go back. Bjorn Fortuin begins with a short ball, around off. Shikhar Dhawan pushes it towards cover. After a bit of a yes and no, Shikhar Dhawan leaves his crease and but he is sent back mid-way. Shikhar Dhawan is a bit late in turning back and getting his bat inside his crease. Quinton de Kock grabs the ball and whips the bails off. The replay confirms Shikhar Dhawan is short of his crease.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Marco Jansen / Quinton de Kock)

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, another length delivery, angling in. Shubman Gill gets beaten on the inside edge while trying to cut this away.
Short this time, outside off. Shubman Gill pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length again, outside off. Shubman Gill looks to cut this but the ball goes off the inside edge onto the deck and towards the keeper.
FOUR! Another boundary from Shubman Gill. He is in a hurry here. Anrich Nortje drops it short, around middle. Shubman Gill swivels and pulls it gently through square leg for a boundary.
Leg bye! Sprays this on the pads, another length delivery. Shikhar Dhawan looks to flick but he misses. The ball goes towards fine leg off his thigh pad. A leg bye taken!
Anrich Nortje starts off from over the wicket, he serves a length ball, outside off, at around 143 clicks. Shikhar Dhawan pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Anrich Nortje comes into the attack. He replaces Lungi Ngidi.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Shubman Gill and India have gotten off to a great start here! This was an even better shot as he picks the short ball early once again and dispatches it towards the deep mid-wicket boundary to collect four more runs to his kitty. 11 runs from this over.
FOUR! That has been swatted away! Marco Jansen continues to bowl slightly short and outside off, Shubman Gill gets on top of the bounce and slaps this towards deep point for four runs.
Bowls this slightly back of a length and outside off, Shubman Gill knocks this towards point.
This is in line with the stumps on a good length, Shubman Gill blocks this back towards the bowler.

Marco Jansen bangs this in short and angles the ball into the batter, Shikhar Dhawan sways out of the way and the ball keeps rising after passing the batter. Quinton de Kock jumps up and is unable to grab it and the batters take a bye.
Full delivery angled into the pads, Shikhar Dhawan flicks this towards deep square leg and takes a couple of runs.
This is outside the off pole on a good length, Shubman Gill defends this towards point.

FOUR! That is a beautiful shot and all you can do is admire it! Lungi Ngidi goes full and in line with the stumps, Shubman Gill gets a small stride forward and punches the ball with a straight bat to the straightish long on fence for four runs.
Lungi Ngidi bowling on a good length here and outside the off stump, Shubman Gill strokes this on the up straight to the cover fielder.
Goes fuller this time and attacks the pads, Shubman Gill clips this to deep square leg and collects a brace.
On a good length once again and outside the off stump, Shubman Gill defends this towards point.
Lungi Ngidi begins the over with a good-length delivery outside off, Shubman Gill decides to leave this one alone.
Continues bowling back of a length and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan dabs this towards point.
Bowls this back of a length and outside the off stump, Shikhar Dhawan rises on his toes and fends this awkwardly towards the off side.
Marco Jansen attacks the stumps on a fuller length, Shikhar Dhawan looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge back down the pitch.
Bowls this outside the off pole on a good length, Shubman Gill guides the ball to third man and takes a run.
This is on a good length and outside off, Shubman Gill blocks this towards mid off.

FOUR! Shubman Gill reaches for this and gets it away to the fence! Marco Jansen bowls this full and really wide outside off, Shubman Gill gets the toes end of the bat and the ball flies past the slip fielder to the third man boundary for four more runs.
This is in line with the stumps on a good length, Shikhar Dhawan taps this towards mid on.

FOUR! That has been crunched away! Great timing on the shot as Shikhar Dhawan picks up his first boundary. Lungi Ngidi serves this full and outside the off pole, Shikhar Dhawan gets on the front foot and drives this to deep cover for a wonderful boundary.
Around the wicket once again and bowls this on a good length, nipping back into the batter. Shikhar Dhawan looks to block but gets an inside edge towards square leg.
Continues bowling full and outside the off stump, Shubman Gill hits this hard towards mid off and a fumble allows the batters to take a run.
Goes over the wicket to the right-hander now and bowls this full and outside off, Shubman Gill blocks this firmly towards mid off.
Lungi Ngidi begins from 'round the wicket and serves this full and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan guides this to third man for a single.
Lungi Ngidi will bowl from the other end.
This is on a good length and attacking the stumps, Shubman Gill blocks this towards mid-wicket. 7 runs from the first over and India are on their way.

FOUR! That is the first boundary for India! Marco Jansen bangs this in short and down leg side, Shubman Gill is on the front foot and has to adjust late as he pulls this towards fine leg for a boundary.
Marco Jansen serves this outside the off pole on a good length, Shubman Gill is watchful as it lets it go through to the keeper.
Goes a fraction full and in line with the stumps, Shubman Gill flicks this straight to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Straying down leg side on a good length, Shubman Gill looks to flick this fine but misses and is called wide by the umpire.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole, Shubman Gill blocks this towards the point fielder.
Marco Jansen sprays this one the thigh pad, another good-length delivery. Shikhar Dhawan helps it towards fine leg for a single. He gets off the mark with that.
No ball! A length ball, outside off, shaping away. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone. Marco Jansen has overstepped on his first delivery. A no ball is called! Free Hit coming up..
